text: わかったよ　でてけば　いいんだろ！

structure.jp: でてけば　いいんだろ！
structure.en: I just have to leave, don't I!

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.explanation: A verb with the 'if' ending ば plus いい means 'it's enough to do that, all one has to do is that'. でてけば いい = 'all I have to do is leave'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end means 'right?' and presses the listener to agree; だろ is the clipped, rough form, here sulky. いいんだろ = 'that's what you want, isn't it!'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb adds the idea of moving away from here. でていけば loses its い in casual speech and becomes でてけば = 'if I get out of here'.
